scientific_question: Does internal migratory readiness primarily control migration activation, with its predictive importance attenuating during post-activation progression?
priority_design: two sequential movement gates using independently measured capture-time Durif stage

primary_cohort.rule: metadata-only individuals absent from processed migration tables are not classified as biological non-migrants

gate1.estimand: ordinal Durif effect on activation probability and time to onset

gate2.endpoint: published sea-escapement success among expert-corrected initiators
gate2.estimand: ordinal Durif effect conditional on activation

primary_phase_test.estimand: difference between Durif coefficients at activation and completion using individual-clustered stacked model

external_confirmation.question: after activation, do barrier-specific opportunity variables explain progression better than residual Durif differences?
reject_if: Durif grouping is changed after outcome inspection
body mass is dropped to manufacture an identifiable stage effect
project-level WRS correlation is presented as causal confirmation

evidence_boundary: developmental independent evidence; outcomes inspected during hypothesis development; Dutch within-route confirmation remains required
